proof.text: Obtain the ordinary sheaf tensor comparison and its local pure-tensor rule from completed_formula_chain_data. Apply NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex and whisker by the inclusion of good complexes. At degree i the resulting map is the sheaf comparison on P.X i, so its generator rule is exactly CompletedFormula. No Roos cone or finite-projection normalization hypothesis is required.
